description: Maps source database engines to AWS RDS/Aurora engine identifiers. Validates engine compatibility and flags cases requiring user decision (engine escape paths).

sqlserver.notes: Aurora not available for SQL Server. Always provisioned.

mariadb.notes: MariaDB and MySQL have diverged (10.6+). Separate RDS engine exists. User may prefer MySQL for ecosystem.

oracle.notes: Many migrations want to escape Oracle licensing → Aurora PostgreSQL. Requires schema conversion (AWS SCT) and app changes.

cockroachdb.notes: Wire-protocol compatible with Postgres. Distributed semantics do not map to RDS. Aurora DSQL may be an alternative for global distribution.

alloydb.notes: GCP Postgres-compatible. Custom extensions may not be available on Aurora.
